title: Roman Numeral Trio Ring
descriptionHtml:
Three metals, one stack, a clock's worth of numerals. Three bands worn as one: a slim rose gold band engraved with Roman numerals and set with small round stones, a silver tone band with two rows of pavé, and a wider gold band with Roman numerals cut right through the metal. Stacked flush, they read as one considered ring.

STYLING TIP: Wear it as your one statement ring with gold and silver pieces alike.

Details

  • Construction: Three bands fixed as one
  • Top: Rose gold tone band engraved with Roman numerals and set with small round stones
  • Middle: Silver tone band with two rows of pavé
  • Bottom: Gold tone band with Roman numerals cut through the metal
  • Height: Approximately 16mm
  • Sizes: US 6, 7 and 8
  • Plating: Rose gold tone, rhodium silver tone and 18k gold tone
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
